Container.Name: justup
Container.Overview:
Know when a service goes down and what happened around it. justUp! checks websites, APIs, hosts, TCP/UDP ports and TLS certificates from one self-hosted dashboard.
Get alerts by email or Signal, inspect route changes and export PDF availability reports. A quality gate pauses checks when your own connection fails, reducing false alarms. One container, built-in SQLite, no external database or agent.
Set a persistent Secret Key before installing. Sign in as admin with the temporary password from the container log, then change it at first login.
Container.ExtraParams: --init --restart unless-stopped --stop-timeout 60 --security-opt no-new-privileges:true --cap-drop ALL --cap-add CHOWN --cap-add FOWNER --cap-add SETUID --cap-add SETGID --cap-add NET_RAW --tmpfs /app/data/pdf_reports:size=256m,mode=0700
Container.Changes: Initial Unraid template with persistent data, a Web UI port and the container's recommended runtime settings.

Config.Name: Secret Key
Config.Description: Required persistent Fernet key for stored secrets, sessions and backups. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32 | tr '+/' '-_'. Keep it when updating.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the justUp! dashboard; the container listens on port 8000.

Config.Name: Persistent Data
Config.Description: SQLite database, monitoring history, settings, Signal data and GeoIP cache. Keep this path when updating.

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: Numeric UID that owns the data directory and runs the app. Cannot be 0 or 10001.

Config.Name: Group ID
Config.Description: Numeric GID that owns the data directory. Cannot be 0 or 10001.

Config.Name: Trusted Proxy IPs
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated reverse-proxy IPs or networks as seen by the container. Leave empty when no proxy is used.

Config.Name: Key Rotation List
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated Fernet keys, new primary key first. Use only when rotating the Secret Key; keep old keys until their stored data has been re-encrypted.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Container log verbosity. Access lines appear only at DEBUG.

Config.Name: Signal Java Initial Heap
Config.Description: Initial Java heap for the bundled Signal integration.

Config.Name: Signal Java Maximum Heap
Config.Description: Maximum Java heap for the bundled Signal integration.
